OCT ’26

A baseline that does not pass is still the result.

VIGIL’s checker units have passed their focused tests, but the full M0 regression has not cleared. The current runtime result is inconclusive. The right next move is to fix the baseline and repeat, not to claim a reliability improvement.

VIGIL / verification
OCT ’26

Mark targets as targets.

PULSAR-4X’s 2.0 GS/s aggregate rate is an architecture target built from four 500 MS/s channels. Until implementation and measurement exist, it belongs in the specification column—not the results column.

PULSAR / mixed-signal
2026

Keep the numerical contract visible.

MHDA’s reported gain and hardware/software error are only useful alongside the fixed-point behavior, topology and simulation conditions that produced them. A metric without its contract is hard to reproduce.

MHDA / fixed-point
ONGOING

Learn the flow, not just the command.

My focus is to understand how RTL decisions turn into synthesis, timing, physical design and test consequences—using scripts and repeatable checks so each result can be inspected.
